wallet_index.title: Hive wallet login
wallet_index.content: Welcome to Hive's official Hive blockchain wallet. Use it to transfer Hive tokens, Power up, vote for Hive Witnesses and change your Hive profile details.

profile.hive_description: Tokens canjeables pueden ser transferidos a cualquier sitio en cualquier momento.1 HIVE y pueden ser convertidos a HIVE POWER en un proceso llamado power up.
profile.hp_description: Tokens con influencia te dan más control sobre los pagos de los posts y te permiten ganar recompensas de curación. Part of {{username}}'s HIVE POWER is currently delegated. Delegation is donated for influence or to help new users perform actions on hive.blog. Your delegation amount can fluctuate. HIVE POWER increases at an APR of approximately {{value}}%, subject to blockchain variance.
profile.hive_dolar_description: Tradeable tokens that may be transferred anywhere at anytime.
profile.savings_description: El saldo está sujeto a 3 días de espera para la retirada. HBD interest rate: {{rate}}% APR (as voted by the <0>Witnesses</0>)

profile.the_next_power_down: The next power down is scheduled to happen in
profile.account_history_description: Tenga cuidado con los enlaces de spam y phishing en los memos de transferencia. No abra enlaces de usuarios en los que no confíe. No proporcione sus claves privadas a sitios web de terceros. Transactions will not show until they are confirmed on the blockchain, which may take a few minutes.
